meta.title: Contribute
meta.description: Run the coverage cells you picked with your own API key, or run locally and open a pull request. Keys are held in memory only.

title: Contribute a run
subtitle: Fill a coverage gap: run the cells you picked with your own key, or clone the runner and open a PR.

empty.title: No cells selected
empty.message: Pick missing or attempted cells on Progress first, then come back here to run them.

steps.title: How contribution works
steps.pick: Pick the cells to fill on Progress.
steps.estimate: Get a live call count and cost estimate.
steps.run: Run them with your own API key.
steps.cost: Typical cost runs from a few cents to a few dollars per cell — it depends on the model and effort tier.

estimate.disclaimer: Calls = N slots × 2 variants per cell. Cost is a planning range from observed data, not a quote.

honesty.title: How your key is handled
honesty.memory: Your key stays in memory only — never written to disk, never logged.
honesty.scope: It is used solely for the runs you selected, then discarded when the job finishes.
honesty.opensource: The runner is open source — you can read exactly what it does with the key.
honesty.review: Community runs land quarantined: visible in the gallery with an unreviewed badge, kept out of the arena until a maintainer reviews them.
honesty.zerotrust: Zero-trust alternative: run the batch locally and open a pull request — no key ever leaves your machine.

result.queued: Run queued (job {jobId}). Track it on Progress once it lands.

errors.beta: The hosted pipeline is in beta and not accepting keys yet — run locally and open a PR instead (below).
errors.queueFull: The run queue is full right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.cellCap: Too many cells — a single job takes at most 12. Remove a few and retry.
errors.noCells: No cells to run — pick some on Progress first.
errors.noKey: An API key is required to queue a hosted run.
errors.badCells: Some selected cells are no longer runnable (already landed). Refresh Progress.
errors.badRequest: The request was rejected. Check the fields and try again.
errors.network: Network error reaching the server. Try again.

beta.title: Hosted pipeline is in beta
beta.body: We are not accepting API keys through the site yet. The zero-trust path is ready today: clone the open-source runner, set your key as an environment variable, run the batch locally, and open a pull request with the landed data. Your key never leaves your machine.
beta.pr: Every community run lands on a review branch — a maintainer merges it.
